# S379 — Spec check skips a vendor marked out

*Proposed.* The spec check's row chain (`specChain`, `internal/daemon/speccheck.go:186`) skips a row whose vendor is marked out, as run admission does, and a spec-check role that exits with the out class marks its vendor out and moves to the next row.

**Findings:** 2026-11-16 20:23: with grok marked out (`ork vendor out grok --until 21:22`), `ork run ork S359` and `ork run ork S179` failed at once with "spec check failed: spec-check (grok grok-4.7 medium) exited unclassified": the spec check still ran its first row (r24, grok). The orchestrator moved ork's spec-check rows to r16,r24 by hand to get past it. · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

*Proposed.* The spec check runs before every start, so one out vendor in its first row blocks every run of the project.
